metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature in Palm Springs, California higher on July 15-21, 2017 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) 8-day composite products (MOD11A2 or MYD11A2) for both 2017 and 2001-2010 baseline. 2. Masking: The 8-day LST product is cloud-screened, so we just mask fill values (-999). 3. Logic: Pull LST for Palm Springs, compute 2017 mean for the DOY window (July 15-21) and compare it to the 2001-2010 mean for the same DOY window. If either collection is empty or has 0 valid pixels, return C1/C2. If the result is None/NaN or outside a physically reasonable range (e.g. < -50°C or > 80°C), return C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') pt = ee.Geometry.Point(-116.5453, 33.8304) # Palm Springs, CA doy_start, doy_end = 196, 202 # 15–21 July # ---------- 2017 snapshot ---------- col17 = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2017, 2017, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(doy_start, doy_end, 'day_of_year')) .select('LST_Day_1km')) if col17.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No 2017 images.") print("C1") exit() lst17 = col17.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15) # scale and convert to °C cnt17 = lst17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if cnt17 == 0: print("No valid 2017 pixels.") print("C2") exit() val17 = lst17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() # ---------- 2001-2010 baseline ---------- colBase = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2001, 2010, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(doy_start, doy_end, 'day_of_year')) .select('LST_Day_1km')) if colBase.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No baseline images.") print("C1") exit() lstBase = colBase.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15) cntBase = lstBase.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() if cntBase == 0: print("No valid baseline pixels.") print("C2") exit() valBase = lstBase.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() # ---------- validation ---------- if val17 is None or valBase is None: print("C3") exit() print(f"2017 LST: {val17:.2f} °C, Pixels: {int(cnt17)}") print(f"2001–2010 avg LST: {valBase:.2f} °C, Pixels: {int(cntBase)}") # ---------- answer ---------- print("A" if val17 > valBase else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

pt = ee.Geometry.Point(-116.5453, 33.8304)  # Palm Springs, CA
doy_start, doy_end = 196, 202  # 15–21 July

# ---------- 2017 snapshot ----------
col17 = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2')
         .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2017, 2017, 'year'))
         .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(doy_start, doy_end, 'day_of_year'))
         .select('LST_Day_1km'))
if col17.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No 2017 images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()
lst17 = col17.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)  # scale and convert to °C
cnt17 = lst17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                           geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
if cnt17 == 0:
    print("No valid 2017 pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()
val17 = lst17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                           geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

# ---------- 2001-2010 baseline ----------
colBase = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2')
           .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2001, 2010, 'year'))
           .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(doy_start, doy_end, 'day_of_year'))
           .select('LST_Day_1km'))
if colBase.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No baseline images.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()
lstBase = colBase.mean().multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)
cntBase = lstBase.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                               geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
if cntBase == 0:
    print("No valid baseline pixels.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()
valBase = lstBase.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                               geometry=pt, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()

# ---------- validation ----------
if val17 is None or valBase is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    exit()
print(f"2017 LST: {val17:.2f} °C, Pixels: {int(cnt17)}")
print(f"2001–2010 avg LST: {valBase:.2f} °C, Pixels: {int(cntBase)}")

# ---------- answer ----------
print("<answer>A</answer>" if val17 > valBase else "<answer>B</answer>")
